label: Agency grid
summary: Minimal editorial agency grid — oversized type, quiet labels, open space
spec:
LAYOUT: disciplined multi-column editorial grid with large open spans and generous negative space; hero headline spans most of the grid with supporting copy anchored in a narrow side column.
PALETTE: light neutral backgrounds, subtle tonal shifts, thin separators; one restrained accent used sparingly.
TYPE: oversized headlines with tight tracking and strong line breaks as the primary visual anchor; tiny uppercase utility labels and metadata; calm, sparse body copy.
SIGNATURE MOVES: service/capability rows as clean multi-column listings with tiny metadata; large architectural image blocks framed by whitespace, not chrome; understated CTAs with thin borders and small uppercase labels.
AVOID: generic repeated card grids, heavy borders or shadows, accent overuse, filling every gap with content.

label: Editorial tech
summary: Magazine composition meets product-tech precision — asymmetric grid, mono labels
spec:
LAYOUT: asymmetrical editorial composition with strong column structure and deliberate negative space; cinematic media bands or inset image strips that cut across the grid; offset alignment instead of centered hero blocks.
PALETTE: restrained dark or controlled light neutrals with one active accent for states, numeric highlights, and focal separators.
TYPE: large expressive display headlines paired with quiet sans body and mono utility labels, counters, and metadata.
SIGNATURE MOVES: chapter markers, step lists, mono counters, thin divider rules and grid traces that make the page feel engineered; premium thin-framed panels rather than soft lifestyle surfaces.
AVOID: centered generic SaaS heroes with interchangeable cards, sci-fi neon chrome, multi-color palettes, accent everywhere.

label: Framed grid
summary: Visible 1px frames and corner brackets on a strict parent grid — precise, technical
spec:
LAYOUT: strict parent grid (e.g. 12 columns) where every section snaps to the same columns and rows; each section is a framed box with a 1px border, consistent padding, and consistent gaps; sections use explicit grid spans, not ad-hoc widths.
PALETTE: neutral background (e.g. #f7f7f4), one border color at low contrast, one stronger line color for accents; very subtle diagonal line texture (≤0.05 opacity) as surface tension.
TYPE: clean sans with calm hierarchy; headings, controls, and media edges all aligned to the same grid rhythm.
SIGNATURE MOVES: L-shaped corner brackets (≈18px) repeated on all major frames; the visible frame IS the structure — no shadows.
AVOID: floating cards, soft blobs, uneven margins, mixed border weights, heavy shadows, decorative texture.

label: Split technical
summary: Two-panel split screen — immersive media one side, specs and metadata the other
spec:
LAYOUT: strong two-panel split (≈50/50 on desktop, stacked on mobile) where each half has a distinct role — one immersive/visual, one informational with specs, metadata, or navigation; thin frame lines, inset rules, and tiny corner markers give each panel a technical shell.
PALETTE: restrained neutrals with one selective accent for active details and system cues, never a blanket wash.
TYPE: quiet editorial headlines with controlled tracking, supported by mono utility text for top rails, metadata strips, and spec labels.
SIGNATURE MOVES: one premium inset surface (bordered media frame or visualization window); compact two-column spec blocks with thin dividers; asymmetric density — one panel denser, one more spatial.
AVOID: generic two-column marketing layouts, equally crowded panels, rounded playful UI, bright multi-color treatments.

label: Wireframe dark
summary: Monochrome technical diagram — outlined geometry, annotations, dark diagnostic frame
spec:
LAYOUT: wide, sparse composition on a near-black foundation; a large outlined/wireframe central object (SVG linework, no external libs) as the structural anchor, surrounded by open space with floating info labels connected by thin routed or dashed lines.
PALETTE: almost entirely monochrome — black, charcoal, zinc, white; emphasis from brightness and line weight, not color.
TYPE: compact technical type — small labels, utility copy, metric text, and only one or two larger heading moments.
SIGNATURE MOVES: exploded/layered outlined geometry suggesting readable components; edge-anchored diagnostic tags with tiny status dots; a low-contrast monochrome widget row (legend, allocation bars); faint halftone or technical pattern overlay.
AVOID: filled glossy 3D renders, bright accent colors, dense dashboard cards competing with the diagram, label clutter.

label: Minimal beige
summary: Warm beige light mode — layered stone surfaces, quiet process grid, sparse accent
spec:
LAYOUT: centered master container or framed shell on layered beige/stone/cream surfaces; simple centered hero above a modular lower grid of evenly divided process blocks with consistent heights.
PALETTE: warm neutrals (beige, stone, parchment) with very low-contrast borders and subtle tonal separation; one sparse accent reserved for badges, active states, and primary actions.
TYPE: modern clean sans, modest weight contrast, quiet tracking, balanced spacing.
SIGNATURE MOVES: gentle radial wash behind the main UI instead of flat white; thin dividers over shadows; small dark inset cards used sparingly as contrast moments; tiny status dots and low-key progress indicators.
AVOID: stark white SaaS with cold gray borders, ornate paper textures, heavy shadows, high-saturation accents, noisy over-filled modules.

label: Dark glass
summary: Premium dark workspace — frosted shells, floating cards, atmospheric depth
spec:
LAYOUT: centered max-width workspace shell on a near-black base — pill top nav, optional side shells, and a calm central stage; thin vertical boundary rails and tiny corner markers keep it architectural; a few floating glass cards around the center, generously spaced.
PALETTE: monochrome — white, zinc, smoke, charcoal; accent only for status dots and tiny indicators.
TYPE: compact operational headings with mono micro-labels, system IDs, and tiny metadata for technical credibility.
SIGNATURE MOVES: dark frosted glass shells (low-opacity dark fills, strong backdrop blur, crisp top-edge highlight, 1px gradient borders); soft atmospheric glow behind the interface; terminal-like I/O cards with clean inner rows.
AVOID: bright translucent cards over colorful blobs, flat black boxes with no depth, center overcrowding, neon glows, glass as card-style-only.

label: Orange paper SaaS
summary: Warm paper tones with orange signal color — rounded, polished, product-led
spec:
LAYOUT: large rounded master container with subtle gradient-border treatment on a warm shell; pair a functional area (form, onboarding, content) with a polished product-visual panel of floating cards or soft white UI chips.
PALETTE: warm off-white, cream, parchment, pale stone surfaces — never stark white; orange as the disciplined signal color for CTAs, step markers, focus rings, and micro-badges.
TYPE: clean sans, light-to-regular body weight, restrained hierarchy — elegant and approachable.
SIGNATURE MOVES: paper-toned inputs with delicate borders and orange focus rings; rounded white/cream cards with soft orange-tinted shadows; orange primary button with quiet secondary actions.
AVOID: cold blue-gray SaaS UI, flat white forms, saturating the page with orange, vintage paper distressing, noisy illustration.

label: Paper technical
summary: Warm paper interior framed by a dark outer shell — tactile but precise
spec:
LAYOUT: dark outer page field holding one large light rounded container with the whole experience inside; inner framing via inset border rectangles, small corner brackets, and quiet technical rules over paper-toned backgrounds.
PALETTE: warm off-white/parchment primary surfaces layered with slightly darker paper tones and soft borders; one restrained accent for active states, progress marks, and primary CTAs.
TYPE: clean sans for interface content with optional mono utility text for timestamps, captions, and metadata.
SIGNATURE MOVES: low-contrast diagonal texture on large paper regions; nested app panels (mockups, sidebars, transcript panes) with bright clean interiors and delicate border hierarchy; accent-driven live states (active bullets, highlighted words).
AVOID: flat plain white layouts, vintage distressing, cold enterprise blue-gray, over-softened consumer roundness, accent overuse.

label: Industrial skeuo
summary: High-contrast molded dark shell — tactile depth, crisp light separation
spec:
LAYOUT: light outer page framing one dominant dark (black/charcoal) rounded master shell; inside, a disciplined grid of molded cards and instrument-like modules with fine guide lines and corner markers.
PALETTE: high contrast — near-white text on deep dark surfaces, muted gray support copy; one restrained signal accent for status lights, active markers, and progress slivers.
TYPE: clean sans with occasional mono labels; precise, not ornamental.
SIGNATURE MOVES: tactile depth via 1px gradient borders, top-edge highlights, dark-to-darker fills, and inset shadow stacks — clean and controlled, never glossy; touchable buttons with subtle bevel and measured hover brightness; selective skeuomorphic objects (windows, search plates, status widgets).
AVOID: washed-out neumorphism, retro glossy leather/chrome gimmicks, flat monochrome with no depth, multiple accents, depth effects on everything.
